sources.name: Auto-Dreamer paper
sources.observed: The paper describes offline consolidation over read-only selected memory regions with provenance-linked source trajectories and reports ScienceWorld gains while using a smaller active memory bank.
sources.scope_guard: Paper-level mechanism/result evidence only; not by itself a run-manifest or checkpoint binding.

sources.name: Auto-Dreamer public dataset
sources.observed: Dataset card says it contains rollout trajectories plus memory-writer outputs for ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and Crafter. ScienceWorld train documents 3592 episodes and test 1819 episodes. The documented files are episodes.jsonl (trajectory-level task/success/score/num_steps), steps.jsonl (observation/action/reward per step), add_groups_mixed.jsonl or add_groups.jsonl (writer outputs) and trace_index.jsonl (task description/action sequence). Preview schema includes trace_id, task_id, success, add_ops, gen_text and writer. Total dataset size shown as 3.24 GB.
sources.scope_guard: This establishes public upstream trajectory-to-writer-output provenance. The inspected dataset layout does not document serialized consolidator rewrite transactions plus paired downstream evaluation outcomes for the paper's intervention arms.

assessment.strongest_new_positive: Auto-Dreamer publishes a substantially stronger source-provenance package than previously inspected ScienceWorld memory systems: immutable public row-level trajectories, step-level observations/actions/rewards, writer outputs, trace identifiers, split manifests and fixed validation sets can be audited without rerunning the original agents.
assessment.remaining_gap: The inspected public surface still lacks a complete intervention-to-outcome package binding consolidator rewrite bytes, exact evaluated checkpoint, pre/post memory state, paired downstream outcomes and verifier/run manifest. Therefore it is not yet a complete scheduled-Chat-native causal replay package.
assessment.phase1_zero_dependency: Static audit of these public bytes is zero incremental monetary cost and does not require hosted compute/model execution. Reproducing original learned consolidation/evaluation live would require unavailable/quota-bearing compute and is not an accepted Phase-1 route.
